## Overview

This project performs a bulk RNA sequencing meta-analysis to investigate molecular changes associated with cardiomyopathy.

The workflow integrates transcriptomic datasets to identify differentially expressed genes, biological pathways, and potential molecular signatures related to cardiac disease.

## Objectives

- Identify differentially expressed genes associated with cardiomyopathy.
- Integrate multiple bulk RNA-seq datasets.
- Explore biological pathways involved in cardiac dysfunction.
- Characterize molecular mechanisms underlying cardiomyopathy.

## Methods

The analysis workflow includes:

- RNA-seq dataset collection and preprocessing
- Quality assessment
- Expression normalization
- Differential gene expression analysis
- Functional enrichment analysis
- Pathway analysis
- Data visualization

## Tools and Technologies

- R programming
- Bioconductor packages
- Bulk RNA-seq analysis workflows
- Differential expression analysis
- Statistical genomics

## Key Analysis Components

The project investigates:

- Gene expression differences between cardiomyopathy and control samples
- Biological processes associated with cardiac remodeling
- Potential candidate genes and pathways for further investigation

## Repository

The complete analysis workflow and source code are available on GitHub:

[View GitHub Repository](https://github.com/drsumayamifty/Cardiomyopathy_bulk_RNAseq_meta_analysis)

## Research Context

Bulk RNA-seq meta-analysis provides a computational approach to integrate transcriptomic datasets and understand molecular alterations associated with cardiovascular diseases.
